title: Hygiene visit with a stopped bisphosphonate and a new diabetes drug

transcript.speaker: HYGIENIST
transcript.text: How was the trip to see your sister in Phoenix?

transcript.speaker: PATIENT
transcript.text: Hot! Anyway, I stopped taking Fosamax in January, my doctor took me off it.

transcript.speaker: PATIENT
transcript.text: And I started metformin last month.

transcript.speaker: HYGIENIST
transcript.text: Thanks, those both matter for us. I'll update your history.

transcript.speaker: HYGIENIST
transcript.text: Cleaning done, light plaque on the lower front teeth.

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: Exam is fine. Back in six months.
